credits_text: UN FILM DI ALBERTO BOGO! CON LA PARTECIPAZIONE DI ELISABETTA LOI PINO SCOTTO TREVOR SADIST WINNER SPECIAL AWARD PARMA INTERNATIONAL MUSIC FILM FESTIVAL 2013
other_text: DUBLE PRODUCTIONS presenta "EXTREME JUKEBOX" un film di ALBERTO BOGO con ALESSIO CHERUBINI ELISABETTA LOI PAOLO PEDERZINI IRENE VILLA ALEX LUCCHESI e la partecipazione MAURIZIO LASTRICO e PINO SCOTTO
moderation_notes: Contains graphic violence and blood; intended for mature audiences.
description: Poster features a guitarist with a grotesque mask holding a bloody axe, alongside cast members and festival awards.
